operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm run verify && pnpm check:deployment-spec && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs check && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs verify-base --offline
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md: stop writes and scheduled work, retain exact source and private configuration, export the complete native archive, restore into a fresh empty installation, establish a fresh owner and re-export to compare data and attachment bytes before routing traffic. Preserve all applied migration names and bytes.
